messages:
Zara: heads-up — saw a spike in tool-invoke parse failures after routing to quantized-4bit for non-prod tenants. ~5% of tool calls returned something our schema validator rejected.
Matt: can you paste an example error?
Zara: sure — snippet from the validator: ```json
{
  "error": "SchemaValidationError",
  "msg": "missing required property 'actions'",
  "model_variant": "quantized-4bit-v2",
  "route": "cost-optimized"
}
```
Len: that matches what we feared — routing policy doesn't account for strict-typed endpoints. We route by latency/cost only.
Anya: important: some endpoints (tools) expect machine-parseable lists. Routing them to lossy variants is risky. We need a policy flag or contract to opt-out.
Matt: agreed. options: 1) add a per-route "schema_strict": true that disables certain variants; 2) have runtime validator return soft-fail + fallback to a safer variant automatically; 3) sample/telemetry to measure real impact before global change.
Zara: fallback will mask the issue if we don't track it in telemetry. Right now failures are swallowed as 500s in user logs. We need both: stricter routing + clear metrics.
Anya: telemetry spec suggestion: metric `toolcall.schema_reject_rate` (tags: tenant_id, model_variant, route_policy, schema_name). Add histogram for latency of fallback path.
Len: also record `toolcall.fallback_triggered` boolean event with sample of raw response (redacted). Console should surface a sampled failing response (with PII scrubbed) and raw schema diff.
Matt: for rollout UX: add a canary gate — block variant=quantized-4bit on routes with schema_reject_rate > 0.5% over 1h. That keeps cost wins but protects correctness.
Anya: cost argument: we can't disable quantized variants entirely; propose config layers: global default (allow), route override (deny), tenant override (allow/deny).
Zara: quick mitigation — I've added a temporary rule to exclude `route: tool-invoke-strict` from cost-optimized routing. That went out 1876320432.
DevDeployBot: deploy succeeded: changed routing-policy config for route=tool-invoke-strict (author=zara). :white_check_mark:
Matt: followups: (a) infra to emit new metrics and expose in console per-route chart; (b) add schema_strict flag to route config; (c) create a UI card that highlights when a variant causes >X rejects; (d) sample 1% of traffic to fallback-safe model to quantify biz impact.
Anya: assign owners: infra: Len for metrics + sampling; platform: Matt for routing/gating; product: Zara for console UX + sample view. I'll track in the rollout doc.
Len: one more note — telemetry keys need stable names for alerting. I'll draft the prometheus/exporter names and the console-mapping PR.
Zara: thanks all. I'll dump a short repro and attach to the console card once Len's metrics are live.
Matt: thanks. tagging @ops-bot for incident awareness if we see regression spike. :face_with_monocle:
